object.label: Indian Ocean South Equatorial Countercurrent

map_features.note: Representative midpoint of variable 5–10°S countercurrent trough on the western 55°E XBT shipping line; not a path endpoint.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Declared 50-90 E eastward winter surface reach. The 50 E start is an OSW offshore truncation beyond the western confluence, and 90 E follows approximate recirculation context. Neither is a diagnosed whole-current terminus. Excludes Somali/East African source legs, the southern return into SEC, South Java continuation, equatorial Wyrtki jets and subsurface SEUC.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

comparability.reason: One December-March surface studied reach with editorial gates and vertices. Other seasonal axes and paired-edge widths are unavailable. Its 4400-4500 km drawing envelope is not annual length variation.

map_features.layer: Surface drifter climatology with GDP drogue support near 15 m and wind-slip-corrected undrogued observations; not a uniform fixed-depth current axis or full vertical extent. OSCAR upper-layer and deeper current diagnostics remain separate.
map_features.note: Source boreal winter December-March convention; Gauss-Markov seasonal climatology using 1993-2018 drifter context. Not a dated trajectory or complete annual route series. One December-March surface studied reach with editorial gates and vertices. Other seasonal axes and paired-edge widths are unavailable. Its 4400-4500 km drawing envelope is not annual length variation.
map_features.source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.2: drifter support, 1993-2018 selection, fitted seasonal fields and December-March winter. Section 3 seasonal discussion after Figures 5-6: eastward SECC reaches about 90 E before recirculating into SEC; Figure 13 caption.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km; planar relation to coarse land-masked OSW display polygons. Source-defined seasonal regional editorial route, not an occupied footprint.
map_features.time_convention: Source boreal winter December-March convention; Gauss-Markov seasonal climatology using 1993-2018 drifter context. Not a dated trajectory or complete annual route series.

scope_notes.label: Winter surface reach versus spectral section regions
scope_notes.source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.2: drifter support, 1993-2018 selection, fitted seasonal fields and December-March winter. Section 3 seasonal discussion after Figures 5-6: eastward SECC reaches about 90 E before recirculating into SEC; Figure 13 caption.
scope_notes.summary: December-March surface drifter context supports the editorial 50-90 E studied reach. A 6-2.5 S frequency/phase classification band at 80.5 E is not paired-edge width. Surface flow stays distinct from the deeper SEUC; whole-current and annual dimensions remain unresolved.
